row.notes: Red-flag state object Update(self, double *dt) (vtable slot ptr 0x14584b198; name kept for signatures.json, per verify-c it describes only the send branch). Phase byte self+0x40: 1 = countdown - subtracts *dt from self+0x48 and, at <= self+0x138, sets +0x130, phase 2 and posts bus msg 0x14584ec98, stores a lap value in +0x70; 2 = deployed - sends the per-vehicle red-flag status (msg 0x14584ecf0 on [self+0x178]+0x3d0) and marks every participant in [self+0x158]+0x108..+0x110 as status 4 in table self+0xe0 (2 bytes per car). Timer +0x131/+0x134/+0x13c clears +0x130/+0x131 when it expires. (used by vmknolle session-watch, red-flag-pit)
